headline: NAYEON drops 2nd 'BABY ANGEL' MV teaser ahead of release
sub: Her first solo single album 'NA-sty' arrives tomorrow at 2 PM KST
source: Source: JYP Entertainment, via Korean media
caption:
TWICE's NAYEON has unveiled the second music video teaser for 'BABY ANGEL', just one day before her solo return.

'BABY ANGEL' leads her first solo single album 'NA-sty', out Nov 20 at 2 PM KST. It's her first solo release in about 2 years and 5 months, following her 2nd mini album 'NA'. The 3-track album also includes 'SHiVER', which NAYEON co-wrote and co-composed, and 'BOY'.

📌 Source: JYP Entertainment, via Korean media (iMBC, Sports Kyunghyang)
